title: 第四章 时空秘典
content_zh:
达到黄极境初期， “气池”变大了数十倍，足有一个篮球那么大。
气池中的真气依旧很稀少，只有鸡蛋那么大的一团，不到气池容量的十分之一。
只有将气池中的真气修满，才能冲击下一个境界，黄极境中期。
张若尘盘膝坐下，闭上双眼，眉心的神武印记
真气，从气池中流出，沿着开辟出来的那一条经脉，流转全身。
随着体内真气的运行，张若尘的身体就像是化为一个漩涡，开始缓缓的吸收天地之间的灵气。
天地灵气，流进眉心的神武印记。
神武印记又将天地灵气转化为真气，储存在气池。真气从气池中流出，沿着经脉，运转全身。
真气在体内运行一圈，便是一个周天。
整整运行了九个周天，当张若尘再次睁开双眼的时候，发现体内的真气数量增加了一倍，达到了气池容量的十分之一。
若是别的武者知道，能够在如此短暂的时间之内，让体内的真气数量提升一倍，肯定会欣喜若狂。
但是，张若尘却有些不满意， “修炼了九个周天，居然才增加了这么一点真气，太慢了！若是能够得到一枚灵晶就好了！我的修炼速度，还能在提升一倍！”
要知道，张若尘修炼的可是《九天明帝经》，吸收真气的速度本来就比那些修炼低等功法的武者要快。
现在的修炼速度，自然让他很不满意。
若是能够有一枚灵晶，就能让修为速度提升一大截。
灵晶，由灵气汇集成晶石。
既可以在地底的矿脉中挖掘 “天然灵晶”，也可以斩杀蛮兽，挖取蛮兽体内的 “后天灵晶”。
一枚灵晶的价值，一般相当于一千枚银币的价值，也只有王孙贵族，或者大家族培养的天才，才有机会得到灵晶。
一千枚银币，对现在的张若尘和林妃来说，绝对是一个庞大的数字，根本不可能买得起。
“灵晶！”

张若尘的心头一动，立即将那一枚一直佩戴在身上的白色枣核形的晶石取出来，托在手掌心。
这会不会是一块灵晶？
体内真气运转，他眉心的神武印记，立即浮现出来，化为一个硬币大小的圆形光晕。
一道白色的真气，从眉心射出，击在白色晶石上面。
“哗！”
白色晶石的表面，浮现出四个古老的文字。
太古怪了！
张若尘从来没有见过这样的文字，却一眼将四个文字认出来—— “时空晶石”。
要知道，在上一世的时候，张若尘也曾将真气注入白色晶石，但是，却从未将晶石表面的文字激发出来。
“上一世，我的修为比现在强大数百倍，也没有让白色晶石的表面出现文字。这一世，才黄极境初期的修为，居然就让白色晶石出现了变化。说明根本不是真气强度的原因，而是真气属性的原因。”
比如，拥有烈焰神武印记的武者，使用火属性的灵晶效果最好，可以达到三倍的修炼速度。使用普通的灵晶，就只能达到两倍的修炼速度。
自然界中，百分之九十的灵晶都没有属性。就像百分之九十的武者，也只能激发出没有属性的武道印记。
“难道我开启的神武印记也拥有某种属性，正好与这一枚时空晶石相契合？等一等，时空晶石是什么东西？”
张若尘上一世可是明帝之子，见识极广，听说过很多属性的灵晶，赤焰灵晶、玄冰灵晶、雷电灵晶、邪血灵晶……，但是，却从未听说过时空
属性的灵晶。
因为，时间和空间根本不是人力可以掌控，就算是神，也不能撼动时间和空间，必须要遵循时间和空间的规则。
就在张若尘还十分不解的时候，时空晶石的表面浮现出一团光晕，化为一个漩涡。
漩涡不断变大，包裹住张若尘的身体。
张若尘只感觉一阵天旋地转，下一刻，他便来到一个密闭的空间，重重的摔落到坚硬的地面上。
幸好他完成了洗髓冲脉，达到黄极境初期，身体增强了不少。若是以他以前脆弱的身体，摔这一下，估计就已经摔死。

张若尘从地上爬起来，活动了一下疼痛的筋骨，开始观察四周的空间。
这个空间完全密闭，看不到门窗。空间的高度，大概是十米，长和宽差不多也是十米左右。
“怎么会这样？我从什么地方进来的？这里又是哪里？咦！那里有一座石台！”
整个空间中，只有一座石台。
石台上面放着一幅卷起来的画，一本银色的铁书。除此之外，便没有别的东西了！
张若尘率先去拿那一幅画，但是，那一幅画却沉重无比，像是和石台连成一体，无论张若尘使用多大的力量，画卷也纹丝不动。
既然将画卷拿不起来，也将画卷打不开，张若尘只能暂时放弃，然后将目光盯向那一本薄薄的银色铁书。
银色铁书的表面，书写着四个字： “时空秘典！”
这一次，张若尘有所准备，将真气运转全身，将全身的力量都调动起来，将《时空秘典》的第一页翻开。
“这么……容易？”
《时空秘典》翻阅起来十分轻松，丝毫都不费力。
张若尘悻悻然的摇了摇头，停止运转真气，将《时空秘典》拿起来，捧在手中，仔细
《时空秘典》的第一页上面记载的并不是什么修炼秘典，而是时空晶石上一代主人 “须弥圣僧”的笔录。
张若尘将须弥圣僧的笔录看完之后，终于明白了所有事。
“原来我开启的神武印记，竟然是时空神武印记。根据须弥圣僧所说，亿万人中也没有一个能够开启时空神武印记。从古至今，仅仅只有两个人，算上我就是三个。”
“须弥圣僧就是第二个开启时空神武印记的人，但是，根据他在《时空秘典》上面记录的时间，他在十多万年前就已经死了。十多万年前，那已经是中古时代，离现在太遥远了。”
张若尘现在所处的空间，就是时空晶石的内空间。
内空间中的时间流动速度和外界完全不一样，在内空间中修炼三天，外界才过去一天。
张若尘大喜，激动得道： “在里面修炼三天，外面才过去一天，岂不是比别人凭空多出三倍的修炼时间？真是太好了。”
张若尘想要翻阅《时空秘典》的第二页，但是无论他使用任何办法，却都无法将第二页翻开。

“又无法
张若尘有一种想要将《时空秘典》摔在地上的冲动，忽然，他看的第一页的最后一排还有一行小字。
“修炼到黄极境小极位，将真气注入画卷，可以将画卷
张若尘再次将目光盯向那一副画卷，心中猜测，画卷中肯定记录了某种神秘的功法，说不定就与修炼时间和空间有关。
“努力修炼，争取早日突破到小极位，倒要看看，画卷里面到底隐藏着什么秘密？”
“小极位”是黄极境的第四个小境界，再往上就是中极位，大极位，大圆满。
张若尘的腹中传来一股饥饿感，便立即从时空晶石的内空间暂时退出去，再次
回到他的房间。
他将时空晶石紧紧的捏在手中，有了这一块晶石，就有更大的把握在三个月之内修炼到黄极境后期。
张若尘、林妃、侍女云儿，坐在一起吃早饭。
吃的东西，仅仅只是白米和馒头，根本看不到肉类。
对于武者来说，消耗的体力比普通人要大得多，吃的东西就显得相当重要。
别的那些开启了神武印记的王子和郡主，每天吃的都是用蛮兽的血液炼制成的 “血丹”，早就不再吃普通的食物。
服下一粒血丹，就能补充一整天的体力消耗，就算修炼一天的拳法、剑法，也不会感到饥饿。
而且，服用血丹还能提升血气，增强武体，增加肉身力量。
若是张若尘就吃白米和馒头，就算每天吃八顿饭，也远远不够身体的消耗。
“尘儿，你现在已经开启神武印记，不能再吃普通的食物。这十枚血丹你先收下，若是不够，娘亲在想别的办法。”林妃将一只玉瓶取出来，递给张若尘。
张若尘正在啃着馒头，根本没有想到林妃居然能够拿出十枚血丹，有些疑惑的道： “娘亲银币才能买到一枚血丹，十枚血丹就枚银币，你哪来那么多钱啊？”
林妃笑了笑，道： “娘亲总是有办法的。”
侍女云儿站在林妃的身后，道： “娘娘是将最喜爱的步摇金钗卖了，才去丹市兑换了十枚血丹！”

林妃轻轻的瞪了云儿一眼，像是在怪她多嘴，随后又道： “尘儿，你别多想，只要你能够修炼成一位真正的武者，娘亲就算将所有饰品全部卖掉，也会支持你修炼下去。”..
张若尘的心中无比感动，紧紧的捏着手中的玉瓶，咬着嘴唇，很想告诉林妃，自己现在已经修炼成一位真正的武者了。
不行，不能这么做。
仅仅一晚上就开辟出气池，完成洗髓冲脉，实在太快了，若是消息不小心走漏出去，肯定会传到别的王子和王后的耳中。到时候，反而会害了自己，也害了林妃。
他现在还是太弱小了，需要更加强大的力量。
content_en:
Reaching the early stage of Huangji Realm, the "Qi Pool" becomes dozens of times larger, as big as a basketball.
The true energy in the qi pool is still very scarce, only a ball the size of an egg, which is less than one-tenth of the capacity of the qi pool.
Only by cultivating the true qi in the qi pool can one reach the next realm, the middle stage of Huangji realm.
Zhang Ruochen sat down cross-legged, closed his eyes, and saw the divine mark between his eyebrows.
True Qi flows out from the Qi pool and flows throughout the body along the opened meridians.
With the movement of the true energy in his body, Zhang Ruochen's body seemed to turn into a whirlpool and began to slowly absorb the spiritual energy between heaven and earth.
The spiritual energy of heaven and earth flows into the divine mark between the eyebrows.
The mark of Shenwu transforms the spiritual energy of heaven and earth into true energy and stores it in the energy pool. True Qi flows out from the Qi pool, along the meridians, and circulates throughout the body.
The true energy circulates in the body for one cycle.
After running for nine full days, when Zhang Ruochen opened his eyes again, he found that the amount of Qi in his body had doubled, reaching one-tenth of the capacity of the Qi pool.
If other warriors knew that they could double the amount of Qi in their bodies in such a short period of time, they would definitely be ecstatic.
However, Zhang Ruochen was a little dissatisfied, "After practicing for nine weeks, I have only gained such a small amount of Qi. It's too slow! It would be great if I could get a spiritual crystal! My cultivation speed can be doubled!"
You must know that Zhang Ruochen practiced the "Nine Heavens Ming Emperor Sutra", and the speed of absorbing the true energy was faster than those warriors who practiced lower skills.
Naturally, he was very dissatisfied with the current speed of cultivation.
If you can have a spiritual crystal, you can speed up your cultivation by a lot.
Spiritual crystals are crystal stones formed by spiritual energy.
You can dig "natural spiritual crystals" from the underground veins, or you can kill wild beasts and dig out the "acquired spiritual crystals" in the beasts.
The value of a spiritual crystal is generally equivalent to the value of a thousand silver coins. Only the nobles, or geniuses cultivated by big families, have the opportunity to obtain spiritual crystals.
One thousand silver coins is definitely a huge number for Zhang Ruochen and Concubine Lin now, and it is impossible to afford it.
"Spirit crystal!"
Zhang Ruochen's heart moved, and he immediately took out the white date-stone-shaped crystal that he had been wearing and held it in the palm of his hand.
Could this be a spiritual crystal?
As the true energy circulated in his body, the divine mark between his eyebrows immediately emerged and turned into a circular halo the size of a coin.
A white qi shot out from between the eyebrows and hit the white crystal stone.
"Wow!"
Four ancient characters appeared on the surface of the white crystal stone.
So weird!
Zhang Ruochen had never seen such words before, but he recognized four words at a glance - "Space-time Crystal".
You know, in his last life, Zhang Ruochen also injected his true energy into the white crystal, but he never inspired the words on the surface of the crystal.
"In the last life, my cultivation was hundreds of times stronger than now, and no words appeared on the surface of the white crystal. In this life, my cultivation at the early stage of Huangji Realm actually caused the white crystal to change. This shows that it is not the strength of the true energy at all, but the attribute of the true energy."
For example, warriors with the Flame Divine Martial Mark will have the best effect using fire-attributed spiritual crystals, which can achieve three times the cultivation speed. Using ordinary spiritual crystals, you can only achieve twice the cultivation speed.
In nature, 90% of spiritual crystals have no attributes. Just like 90% of warriors, they can only inspire martial arts marks without attributes.
"Could it be that the Divine Martial Seal I opened also has certain properties that match this space-time crystal? Wait a minute, what is the space-time crystal?"
Zhang Ruochen was the son of Emperor Ming in his previous life. He was very knowledgeable and had heard of many kinds of spiritual crystals, such as red flame spiritual crystals, black ice spiritual crystals, thunder and lightning spiritual crystals, evil blood spiritual crystals..., however, I have never heard of time and space.
Attribute spiritual crystal.
Because time and space cannot be controlled by humans at all. Even gods cannot shake time and space. They must follow the rules of time and space.
Just when Zhang Ruochen was still very puzzled, a halo of light appeared on the surface of the space-time crystal and turned into a vortex.
The vortex continued to grow, wrapping Zhang Ruochen's body.
Zhang Ruochen felt like the world was spinning. The next moment, he came to a closed space and fell heavily to the hard ground.
Fortunately, he completed the Marrow Cleansing and Chongmai, reached the early stage of Huangji Realm, and his body strengthened a lot. With his fragile body before, he would probably have died if he fell this time.
Zhang Ruochen got up from the ground, moved his painful muscles, and began to observe the surrounding space.
This space is completely airtight, with no doors or windows visible. The height of the space is about ten meters, and the length and width are also about ten meters.
"How could this happen? Where did I come in? Where is this? Hey! There is a stone platform there!"
There is only one stone platform in the entire space.
There is a rolled-up painting and a silver iron book placed on the stone platform. Apart from that, there is nothing else!
Zhang Ruochen took the lead to get the painting, but the painting was extremely heavy, as if it was integrated with the stone platform. No matter how much force Zhang Ruochen used, the painting would not move at all.
Since he couldn't pick up the scroll and couldn't open it, Zhang Ruochen could only give up temporarily and stare at the thin silver iron book.
There are four words written on the surface of the silver iron book: "Secret Code of Time and Space!"
This time, Zhang Ruochen was prepared. He circulated his true energy throughout his body, mobilized all his strength, and opened the first page of the "Secret Code of Time and Space".
"So...easy?"
"Secret Code of Time and Space" is very easy to read without any effort.
Zhang Ruochen shook his head angrily, stopped circulating his Qi, picked up the "Secret Code of Time and Space", held it in his hand, and carefully
What is recorded on the first page of the "Secret Code of Time and Space" is not a secret code of cultivation, but the transcript of the previous owner of the space-time crystal, "Holy Monk Xumi".
After Zhang Ruochen read the transcript of Saint Monk Xumi, he finally understood everything.
"It turns out that the Divine Martial Seal I opened is actually the Space-Time Divine Martial Seal. According to Saint Monk Xumi, not one among hundreds of millions of people can open the Space-Time Divine Martial Seal. From ancient times to the present, there are only two people, including me, there are three."
"Holy Monk Xumi was the second person to open the mark of the divine martial arts of time and space. However, according to the time he recorded in the "Secret Code of Time and Space", he died more than 100,000 years ago. More than 100,000 years ago, that was already the Middle Ages, which is too far away from now."
The space that Zhang Ruochen is currently in is the inner space of the space-time crystal.
The flow speed of time in the inner space is completely different from that in the outside world. After practicing in the inner space for three days, only one day passes in the outside world.
Zhang Ruochen was overjoyed and said excitedly: "I practiced for three days inside and only one day passed outside. Isn't it three times more time to practice than others out of thin air? It's really great."
Zhang Ruochen wanted to turn to the second page of the "Secret Code of Time and Space", but no matter what method he used, he could not open the second page.
"Can't
Zhang Ruochen had the urge to throw the "Secret Code of Time and Space" to the ground. Suddenly, there was a line of small words in the last row of the first page he was looking at.
"Cultivation to the small extreme level of Huangji Realm, injecting true energy into the scroll, you can turn the scroll into
Zhang Ruochen stared at the scroll again, guessing in his mind that some mysterious technique must be recorded in the scroll, perhaps related to the time and space of cultivation.
"Practice hard and strive to break through to the Xiaoji position as soon as possible. But let's see what secrets are hidden in the scroll?"
"Little Extreme Position" is the fourth small realm of Huangji Realm.It is the middle pole position, the great pole position, and the great perfection.
Zhang Ruochen felt a sense of hunger in his belly, and he immediately temporarily withdrew from the inner space of the space-time crystal, and once again
Back to his room.
He held the space-time crystal tightly in his hand. With this crystal, he would be more confident that he could reach the late stage of Huangji Realm within three months.
Zhang Ruochen, Concubine Lin, and maid Yun'er were sitting together to have breakfast.
The food they ate was just white rice and steamed buns, with no meat at all.
For warriors, the physical strength consumed is much greater than that of ordinary people, so what they eat is very important.
The other princes and princesses who have opened the mark of divine martial arts eat "blood pills" made from the blood of wild beasts every day, and have stopped eating ordinary food for a long time.
Taking one blood pill can replenish your physical strength for a whole day. Even if you practice boxing and swordsmanship for a day, you will not feel hungry.
Moreover, taking blood pills can also improve blood energy, strengthen martial body, and increase physical strength.
If Zhang Ruochen only eats white rice and steamed buns, even if he eats eight meals a day, it will not be enough for his body.
"Chen'er, you have now activated the Divine Martial Seal and can no longer eat ordinary food. Please accept these ten blood pills first. If they are not enough, my mother is thinking of other ways." Concubine Lin took out a jade bottle and handed it to Zhang Ruochen.
Zhang Ruochen was eating steamed buns. He never thought that Concubine Lin could actually take out ten blood pills. He said with some confusion: "My mother can only buy one blood pill with silver coins. Ten blood pills are only worth one silver coin. Where did you get so much money?"
Concubine Lin smiled and said, "Mother always has a way."
The maid Yun'er stood behind Concubine Lin and said, "The empress sold her favorite golden hairpin, and then went to the elixir market to exchange it for ten blood pills!"
Concubine Lin lightly glared at Yun'er, as if blaming her for talking too much, and then said: "Chen'er, don't think too much. As long as you can cultivate into a real warrior, my mother will support you in your cultivation even if you sell all your accessories."...
Zhang Ruochen was extremely moved. He squeezed the jade bottle in his hand tightly and bit his lip. He wanted to tell Concubine Lin that he had now become a true warrior.
No, you can't do that.
It was too fast to open the qi pool and complete the marrow cleansing and channeling in just one night. If the news accidentally leaked out, it would definitely reach the ears of other princes and queens. When the time comes, it will harm himself and Concubine Lin.
He is still too weak now and needs more strength.
